upstream.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
upstream.notes: 当前上游版本只有 `hermes serve` 会监听 HTTP 端口；`hermes gateway run` 是消息平台网关，不绑定 8642。依赖改用 PyPI 包安装，避免源码构建时的可选依赖冲突。

commands.setup: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade hermes-agent
commands.start: python -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" serve --port 8642 --skip-build

integration.summary: 2026-11-13 Linux 实测：PyPI 包 hermes-agent 用 `hermes serve --port 8642 --skip-build` 启动后，http://127.0.0.1:8642/api/status 返回 200；`hermes gateway run` 不监听该端口，/health 在该版本返回 404。Windows 路径需按同一命令复验一次。

commands.setup: python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install --target vendor/${CLAWHERMES_RUNTIME_KEY} hermes-agent aiohttp==3.13.3
commands.start: python3 -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" serve --port 8642 --skip-build

integration.summary: macOS adapter uses portable python3 plus a movable vendor/<darwin-arch> dependency directory prepared on a macOS build host; start runs hermes_cli.main from USB_ROOT without reusing the Windows venv.
